title: Organisation (company / lab behind a model)
description: One YAML file per organisation in data/orgs/<id>.yaml. Models reference it via `org`; `company`/`country` on each model are copied from here and checked by the validator.

country.description: Country of the organisation's headquarters, as named by the source (e.g. 'United States of America', 'China').

aliases.description: Other names sources use for this organisation.

hf_orgs.description: Hugging Face organisations that publish this org's official weights.
